title: Full-Time Book Creative Writer & Editor for Nonfiction Books | Remote
description:
Work Setup: Remote / Work From Home

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 7:30 PM Philippine Time (1-hour unpaid break included)

Total Work Hours: 48 hours per week under a compressed workweek schedule



About the Role:



We are looking for a skilled and creative Writer & Editor for Nonfiction Books who can help develop, write, improve, and polish Taglish and English manuscripts for Filipino readers.



This role is ideal for someone who can write clearly, organize ideas well, edit with strong attention to detail, and make nonfiction books engaging, practical, and easy to understand.



AI tools may be used as part of the writing and editing workflow, but the final output must be human-refined, well-structured, original, natural, and suitable for the target market. We are not looking for someone who only copies AI-generated content. We need a writer-editor who can use AI wisely while applying creativity, judgment, research, and strong editorial skills.



Responsibilities:



Write and improve nonfiction book manuscripts in Taglish and/or English

Develop chapter outlines, book flow, titles, subtitles, examples, and key takeaways

Edit drafts for clarity, grammar, structure, tone, flow, and readability

Improve AI-assisted drafts to make them sound natural, human, practical, and engaging

Remove repetitive, generic, boring, or overly academic content

Make the manuscript relatable and suitable for Filipino mass-market readers

Check weak sections, confusing ideas, awkward wording, and inconsistent tone

Research topics, reader problems, and practical examples when needed

Follow the required writing style, voice, structure, and brand direction

Revise manuscripts based on feedback from the publishing team

Meet agreed deadlines without sacrificing quality:



Qualifications:



Experience in writing or editing books, ebooks, long-form content, articles, blogs, scripts, or educational materials

Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and content organization skills

Can write naturally in Taglish and/or English

Understands Filipino readers and practical nonfiction writing style

Knowledgeable in using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar tools as part of the writing workflow

Can improve AI-assisted content instead of simply copying or relying on AI output

Creative, detail-oriented, organized, and deadline-driven

Can follow instructions and work independently

Open to feedback and revisions



Preferred Experience:



Experience writing or editing any of the following is a plus:



Business books

Self-help books

Motivational books

Educational books

Practical guide books

Filipino/Taglish nonfiction content

Social media or marketing content



Required Output Per Manuscript:



Chapter outline or improved book structure

Written or edited manuscript draft

Revised manuscript after feedback

Clean final version

Editorial notes or list of concerns, if any

Research notes or references used, if applicable



Skills Test:



Shortlisted applicants will be given a short writing and editing test to assess writing quality, creativity, clarity, grammar, structure, AI-assisted workflow, and ability to write for Filipino readers.



The test will be used strictly for skills assessment purposes only.



How to Apply:



Interested applicants may send the following to







• Updated resume/CV

• Sample edited work, if available

• Short introduction about your editing experience



Subject Line: Application – Book Creative Writer / Editor



Important: Applicants who send their complete application requirements directly through
 will be given priority in the review process.

Read this entire post before applying. Lazy or generic applications will be ignored.

The Role

This is not a multi-tasking role. This is not appointment setting on the side. Your entire shift is finding people and getting them to apply. If you can't stay locked in on a single mission, do not apply.

You won't be recruiting for some sink-or-swim operation. We hand every new agent FREE leads — they don't pay for them and they don't have to cold-prospect from scratch. The math is simple: an agent who puts in a real 8–10 hour day and actually works the leads we give them has a near-certain shot at making money in their first month. That's your pitch. You're not begging people to take a gamble — you're offering them a real opportunity with the leads, training, and support already in place. Use that.

Source and recruit US-based sales agents full-time — this is 100% of the job

Hunt across every channel that works: LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, Google,
 groups, Indeed, job boards, cold DMs, anything that gets a qualified person to apply

Start real conversations, handle replies, and drive candidates to fill out our application

Hit daily outreach volume and track everything

People who "think they can figure it out"

People doing two or three other jobs at the same time

People who send 10 messages and call it a day

People who need to be micromanaged



Who I AM Looking For



Proven recruiting, sourcing, or high-volume outreach experience — and you can prove it with numbers

Someone who treats this like their own business and stays locked in for the full shift

Strong written English and a confident, professional tone in messages

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and zero excuses about showing up



Schedule

Your working hours must fall within 6:00 AM – 8:00 PM Pacific Standard Time (US hours) so you overlap with the US workday. This is non-negotiable.

Note: the sales agents you'll be recruiting work a minimum 8-hour day themselves — so you'll be looking for people ready to commit to real full-time work, not casual side hustlers.

title: Cost Accountant
description:
Part-time Cost Accountant – Ostendo EAP Specialist, remote role

Part-time Cost Accountant – Ostendo & MYOB Specialist



 Part-time / Contract

 Fully remote — anywhere

 Ostendo + MYOB required

 Sportswear / Direct Import

 Schools & Sports Clubs

 Inventory & Ecommerce

 Data Cleanup Priority

About us



We are a New Zealand-based business supplying customised sportswear direct from China to schools and sports clubs. Sponsorship is a core part of how we serve our customers. Our operations run on Ostendo EAP integrated with MYOB, and we sell through both direct and ecommerce channels. We have an immediate need to address item code and data cleanup alongside ongoing finance and inventory management responsibilities.



About the role



This is a fully remote, part-time contract role open to candidates anywhere in the world. You will be the Ostendo and MYOB system expert on our team — working closely with our NZ-based bookkeeper and external accountant to ensure the financial and operational engine of the business is running accurately and to its full potential.



Who you'll work with: You'll collaborate directly with our in-house bookkeeper (day-to-day transactions and data entry) and our external accountant (compliance, tax, and period-end). Your role is the bridge — owning the EAP system, cost structures, inventory integrity, and reporting quality that both of them depend on.



Key responsibilities



Item code & data cleanup — immediate priority



Our item code library and product descriptions have accumulated significant duplication and inconsistency. This is a hands-on cleanup project with real urgency — server storage constraints mean it needs to be addressed promptly and methodically.



Audit the full item code library in Ostendo — identify duplicates, redundant codes, obsolete items, and inconsistent naming conventions

Standardise product descriptions across all active items — clear, consistent, and suitable for quotes, invoices, and ecommerce listings

Develop and apply a logical item coding structure that supports accurate reporting and scalable growth

Merge, archive, or delete redundant records — carefully managing linked transactions, open orders, and historical data before any removal

Identify and reduce unnecessary data accumulation contributing to server storage pressure

Document new item code conventions so the bookkeeper and team can maintain consistency going forward

Inventory management & stocktakes



Plan and coordinate monthly physical stocktakes with the local team — count sheets, variance investigation, and sign-off

Reconcile physical counts against Ostendo inventory records; investigate and resolve variances

Process inventory adjustments in Ostendo and ensure these are correctly reflected in MYOB

Maintain accurate stock valuations and monitor slow-moving or obsolete stock

Ecommerce inventory accuracy



Ensure inventory levels in Ostendo sync correctly with ecommerce platform(s) — preventing overselling or stockout errors

Review and tighten the ecommerce fulfilment workflow — order receipt, picking, dispatch, stock deduction, returns, and cancellations

Ensure cleaned-up item codes and descriptions flow correctly into ecommerce product listings

Stock receipting & MYOB integration



Manage end-to-end stock receipting in Ostendo — purchase order through to goods receipt and inventory posting

Ensure stock receipts and supplier invoices are reconciled and posted correctly into MYOB

Oversee the sales invoicing process — correct coding, GST treatment, and customer allocation in MYOB

Support the bookkeeper with transaction queries and system issues as they arise

Freight & import costing



Ensure landed costs (freight, customs, duties) on China direct imports are correctly captured and allocated to stock

Review freight links and integrations within Ostendo for accuracy

Costing, quoting & margin reporting



Review and validate the quoting module — ensure cost and selling prices are correctly configured for margin reporting

Maintain costing templates for consistent quoting on customised sportswear orders

Prepare margin and management reports for the business owner and external accountant as required

Sponsorship accounting



Establish or review accounting treatment for sponsorship arrangements — income, contra, or in-kind classification

Ensure sponsorship transactions appear correctly in Ostendo, MYOB, and margin/P&L reporting

CRM & system reporting



Audit CRM data — customer records, pricing tiers, and contact links for schools and clubs

Reviewscript-based reports; flag or correct broken logic or outdated references

Recommend improvements to ensure Ostendo is operating to its full potential

What we're looking for



Proven, hands-on experience with Ostendo EAP — this is the core requirement; candidates without direct Ostendo experience are unlikely to be suitable

Strong MYOB experience — inventory, invoicing, purchase and supplier workflows

Background in cost accounting, inventory accounting, or finance operations in an import, distribution, or product-based business

Demonstrated ability to audit and rationalise product/item master data in an ERP — this is a key requirement for the immediate project

Experience coordinating stocktakes remotely and reconciling inventory variances

Understanding of ecommerce inventory management — stock sync, fulfilment, and returns

Solid grasp of landed cost allocation and direct import stock flows; NZ GST knowledge helpful but not essential

Comfortable working remotely and collaborating with a small team across time zones via
, video, and shared systems

Familiarity with sponsorship accounting is a distinct advantage

Methodical and process-driven — able to work through large volumes of legacy data carefully and accurately

Role details



Engagement type



Part-time or contract



Location



Fully remote — worldwide



Hours



Flexible — to be agreed



Start



As soon as available

We're a fast-growing U.S.-based B2B consulting and business services company. We work with small and mid-sized service businesses across the U.S. — law firms, accounting firms, marketing agencies, and professional services — helping them solve operational and growth problems.

We have a proven offer, real budget, real systems, and a U.S. founder who's done LinkedIn outbound himself. You're not getting handed garbage tools and unrealistic targets. You're getting set up to win.



The Role

You'll own our LinkedIn outbound engine. That means:



Running LinkedIn outreach campaigns through Sales Navigator (and automation tools like HeyReach, Expandi, Dripify, or Linked Helper)

Building targeted prospect lists using Sales Nav filters, Boolean search, and Apollo / Clay for enrichment

Writing and testing connection request notes, follow-ups, and DMs that don't sound like every other setter on LinkedIn

Managing the founder's LinkedIn inbox daily — replying to inbound messages in real time, qualifying leads, and booking discovery calls

Engaging with prospect content (likes, thoughtful comments) to warm up before outreach

Running multi-touch sequences: connect ? thank ? value message ? soft ask ? meeting

Sending confirmation and reminder messages to protect show-up rate

Maintaining clean CRM records (HubSpot)

Reporting weekly on connection acceptance rate, reply rate, meetings booked, and show-up rate



This isn't a "spray 200 connection requests a day and pray" role. This is a thinking setter role. You'll read replies, adjust messaging, kill bad sequences, and double down on what works.



Compensation

ComponentAmountBase Salary$1,000 – $1,500/month (based on experience)Per-Meeting Bonus$50 per qualified meeting that showsClosed-Deal Commission% of deals you source (discussed in interview)13th Month PayYesPaid PH HolidaysYesTools & SoftwareAll provided (Sales Nav, automation tools, CRM)

Realistic earnings: $1,500–$2,500+/month for a strong performer.



What You Need to Have

? 2+ years of LinkedIn outbound experience targeting U.S. decision-makers

? Excellent written English — your messages need to sound human and American, not robotic

? Hands-on experience with Sales Navigator + at least one automation tool (HeyReach, Expandi, Dripify, Linked Helper, etc.)

? Real metrics from past roles — connection acceptance %, reply %, meetings/month (you'll need screenshots)

? Understanding of LinkedIn account safety — daily limits, warmup, avoiding restrictions

? Reliable internet (50+ Mbps), backup power, dedicated workspace

? Comfort on Loom and Zoom — we do weekly check-ins

? U.S. Eastern Time overlap — at least 4 hours daily between 9am–5pm EST

? Bonus points if you have:



Experience targeting law firms, agencies, or professional services

Copywriting chops — you write your own DMs, not just rip templates from YouTube

Experience with multi-channel sequences (LinkedIn +
 combined)

Apollo or Clay experience for list-building and enrichment

HubSpot or similar CRM fluency





What You'll Get Beyond the Paycheck



Direct access to a U.S. founder — no middle managers, no agency BS

A real seat at the table — your input on messaging, targeting, and strategy actually matters

Long-term stability — we're not hiring for a 3-month project, we want someone for years

Growth path — first setter can grow into a Head of Outbound role as we scale

Tools, training, and templates — you won't be reinventing the wheel

A boss who actually understands LinkedIn outbound — I've run it myself





What This Role Is NOT

???? Not a "blast 100 connection requests a day" volume game — we care about quality meetings

???? Not a sweatshop — 40 hours, clear KPIs, no weekend grinds

???? Not for beginners — if you've never run real LinkedIn outbound, this isn't the fit (yet)



How to Apply

I get 100+ applications on every post. To save us both time, applications missing ANY of these will be auto-rejected. No exceptions.



Your resume (PDF)

A 2–3 minute Loom video answering: "What's the best LinkedIn outbound campaign you've ever run, and what were the actual numbers?" (connection acceptance rate, reply rate, meetings booked)

Timeline

Competitive base salary based on experience

HMO coverage

Leave credits

13th Month Pay

Career growth — we're building a 50+ person capability centre within 12 months

Track record across multiple industries

title: Betting Operations & VM Management
description:
OPENING STATEMENT



We are looking for a full-time Betting Operations & VM Management Assistant to join a growing Australian professional betting operation.



Your main job will be managing a fleet of Windows virtual machines that run automated betting software. Every day, you will log into each VM using remote desktop tools, check that the betting software is running, confirm that bookmaker accounts are logged in, fix any issues that come up, and keep accurate records of everything. On busy race days (especially Saturdays), you will need to check more often because bookmakers can log out mid-session. You will also help with small admin tasks like signing up to new bookmaker accounts as the operation grows.



If you have experience in online operations, VM management, remote desktop work, data entry, betting admin, or similar detail-heavy technical roles - and you are comfortable doing repetitive work to a high standard every day - we want to hear from you.



WHAT WE OFFER



* Full-time, stable, long-term role with an Australian business.

* 40 hours per week, Wednesday to Sunday.

* 20,000php starting salary during probation. 23,500php + 1,500php benefits post probation (~1month)

* Full training provided on all systems and tools.

* Fully remote - work from home.

* 13th month pay.

* Government-mandated benefits.



WHAT YOU'LL DO (TRAINING PROVIDED)



* Log into Windows virtual machines via remote desktop every day and check that they are running correctly.

* Monitor automated betting software on each VM - confirm sessions are active, bookmakers are logged in, and there are no errors.

* On Saturdays and busy race days, check VMs more frequently to catch bookmakers that log out mid-session.

* Fix common issues - restart frozen VMs, re-log bookmaker accounts, restart betting software sessions.

* Escalate infrastructure-level problems (proxy connections, VPN, server issues) to the technical support team.

* Maintain accurate tracking records - account balances, VM statuses, and operational data.

* Sign up to new bookmaker accounts as instructed, following the exact process provided.

* Provide daily updates to the owner on the state of the operation.



REQUIREMENTS



* Technically proficient - you pick up new software quickly and can troubleshoot basic issues independently.

* Comfortable working inside Windows remote desktop environments for extended periods.

* Strong attention to detail - the same checks across many VMs every day, and accuracy matters.

* Genuinely comfortable with repetitive, routine work done to a high standard.

* Proactive communicator - you raise issues immediately, not later.

* Available to work Wednesday to Sunday, including Saturday mornings from 9:00am AEST.

* Reliable computer and stable internet connection.



NICE TO HAVE



* Prior experience in betting operations, matched betting, or bookmaker account management.

* Experience with automated betting tools.

* Experience using Airtable or similar tracking tools.

* Experience with remote desktop tools (RDM, AnyDesk, TeamViewer).



SCHEDULE



* Full-time, 40 hours per week.

* Wednesday to Sunday, 8 hours per day.

* Weekdays: 11:00am to 7:00pm AEST.

* Saturdays: 9:00am start.

* Australian timezone (AEST/AEDT).



This role suits someone who is technically capable, comfortable with routine, and looking for stable long-term work with an Australian business. If you enjoy keeping systems running, doing detail-heavy work accurately, and being relied on to manage things independently - apply now.



HOW TO APPLY



Click "APPLY FOR THIS JOB" button on this job post.

Fill in the Subject field (this is required, but it will not affect your application outcome).

Optionally, you may write a message.

Click Send
.

Once your application is submitted, you will receive an
 from us with the next steps and instructions for the hiring process.

title: Personal Assistant
description:
About This Role:



Praxis Partners is a premium consulting firm delivering Digital-Department-as-a-Service (DDaaS) to established mid-market businesses. Josh O'Sullivan and Leanne Van Rensburg are the founding couple behind it. This role sits outside the business entirely. You are not supporting a company. You are supporting two people who run one. There is also a strong connection of liaison with the company EA and in some cases the Head of Operations. 



Your job is to protect their personal time, keep their private lives running at zero friction, and handle everything that exists outside of office hours and client work. That means family, home, health, travel, household admin, and the dozens of small but important things that fall through the cracks when two busy founders are also parents.



This is not a task-ticker role. You will be trusted with sensitive personal and family information, expected to think ahead, and given real ownership over a domain that matters deeply to Josh and Leanne.



What Your Day Might Look Like:

- Process personal
 inboxes (Josh and Leanne) to inbox zero by 9:00 AM AEST and again by 4:30 PM AEST, AI-assisted and pre-filtered

- Review and manage personal calendars for the current day and next, flagging anything that needs attention

- Prepare the agenda for Josh's daily personal admin catch-up

- Track parcels, confirm bookings, coordinate household logistics

- Action a daily to-do list pulled from
, Notion, Slack, and voice messages

- Liaise with the Executive Assistant on any personal matters that cross into business scheduling, communications, or priorities to ensure nothing falls between the two roles



What Your Week Might Look Like:

- Audit personal calendars 6 weeks ahead: confirm invites, check for conflicts, verify all details

- Send a "Week Ahead" personal brief to Josh every Monday morning

- Confirm family commitments: cleaner schedule, childcare/nanny bookings, appointments, family contacts

- Review personal subscription renewals and expenses

- Follow up on any outstanding personal or family correspondence



What Your Month Might Look Like: 

- Reconcile personal costs against the internal SaaS tracker

- Process and follow up on personal invoices (AI pre-processed)

- Review property management, investment, and household correspondence



Personal and Household:

- Coordinate the weekly cleaner schedule

- Manage childcare and nanny bookings

- Liaise with the property management agent (rent, inspections, strata)

- Track deliveries and parcels

- Book personal appointments (medical, wellness, etc.)



When Required: 

- Book domestic and international travel for Josh, Leanne, and family: flights, accommodation, transport, calendar events with all confirmation details

- Purchase personal items, gifts for family and friends, household needs



Tools You Should Know (or Learn Quickly): 

You don't need to know all of these on day one. Experience with at least 5 is expected.



- Communication and Scheduling Gmail / Google Workspace, Zoom, Slack, WhatsApp

- Documentation and Admin Notion w/AI, Loom

- AI Tools Claude AI, Perplexity, Comet Browser Agent, Granola AI

- Finance and Access Xero (visibility only), 1Password





Who You Are:

- 2+ years supporting a founder, CEO, or couple as a Personal 

- Strong written English (C1/C2). You will communicate with family contacts, vendors, service providers, and personal stakeholders on behalf of Josh and Leanne

- Working in or available for AEST-adjacent timezone hours

- Already using AI tools daily, not just aware of them

- Organised to an unusual degree. Multiple inboxes, busy calendars, overlapping personal admin, nothing gets dropped

- Proactive by nature. You notice what's coming before being told. We use the 1-3-1 Rule: 1 problem, 3 options, 1 recommendation

- Comfortable with Loom-based onboarding

- Discreet. You will be trusted with family schedules, financial correspondence, and personal decisions

- Reliable setup: stable internet, quiet workspace, backup power



Bonus points if you have:

- Experience supporting an Australian, Singaporean, or Thai-based principal

- Experience supporting a couple who run a business together

- Familiarity with Notion as a working system



What You Get:

- Direct hire

- Founders who onboard properly: daily check-ins for weeks 1-4, then 3x/week, then weekly

- Full Loom training library for every task (Camcorder Method)

- Access to modern AI tools and current hardware

- Paid ongoing training and development

- Long-term role with genuine stability

- Weekly pay for the first 2 months, then fortnightly or weekly by preference

- Performance bonuses and OKR incentives

- Travel and expenses covered when required



How to Apply: 

Do not send a generic cover letter. Applications that don't answer all four questions will not be reviewed.



1. Tell us about a time you had to manage several competing personal or family priorities for someone else, all at once, with incomplete information. Don't describe the task. Describe what you d
, what you didn't do, and why. (3-5 sentences.)



2. Something went sideways in your principal's personal life and they were unreachable. Walk us through your thought process. We're not looking for what you did. We're looking for how you think. (3-4 sentences.)



3. Name 3 AI tools you've used in the last 30 days. One sentence each: what you used it for, and one thing it still can't do well.



4. Your expected hourly rate in USD, AUD, or SGD, and your available start date.



5. Include the keyword "Flights-Meetings-Followups" or your application will not be reviewed.

title: Calling All MASTER ACCOUNTANTS | WE WANT YOU!
description:
We're looking for an Accounts & Finance Manager to own the financial backbone of the business — someone who lives in Xero, keeps our books clean and current, runs payroll without a hitch, and can sit down with the director to make sense of the numbers and where they're heading.

The compensation is $800–$1,600 USD/month, depending on experience, with room above the band for a qualified accountant (CPA/CA) who can lead deeper financial analysis and forecasting.

This is a fully remote role based in the Philippines.

We're a digital marketing agency focused on helping local trades and service businesses grow through search. By 2026, our goal is to become the most trusted name in Local SEO across New Zealand, the USA, and Australia for service businesses.

We've grown fast — and as we scale, the finance side needs an owner. Right now the director is carrying too much of the bookkeeping, reconciliation, and payroll himself, and that's not where his time should go. We need someone to take the books off his plate entirely: keep everything reconciled in Xero, structure our chart of accounts properly, run a clean payroll, and give us reporting and forecasts we can actually make decisions from. The tools and systems are there to support you — what we need now is someone to own the function and bring order to it.

This is where the Accounts & Finance Manager role comes into play.

What the Role Entails:



Owning day-to-day bookkeeping and reconciliation in Xero, bank feeds, transactions, accounts payable and receivable, keeping the books clean, current, and reconciled to the dollar

Coding transactions accurately and consistently in Xero, so every dollar lands in the right place and our reporting actually means something

Organising and refining our chart of accounts, building a logical structure that reflects how the business genuinely operates and makes reporting and analysis easy

Owning accounts receivable end to end, keeping invoices organised, tracking what's outstanding, and making sure money owed to us actually comes in

Chasing up overdue invoices and following through until they're paid, staying on top of ageing balances so receivables don't drift

Working closely with the account managers, coordinating on overdue or at-risk invoices so the right client conversations happen and nothing falls through the cracks

Running and organising payroll, coordinating pay runs for tea
mbers and contractors, and making sure everyone is paid correctly and on time

Handling payroll reconciliation, tying pay runs back to the books and resolving any discrepancies before they become problems

Reconciling our payment platforms, Stripe, bank accounts, and any other processors, so income is captured accurately and nothing slips through

Preparing financial reports when requested, P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, and anything else the director needs to see clearly and quickly

Running month-end close, making sure each period is tidied, reconciled, and reported on a consistent rhythm

Reviewing forecasts with the director, maintaining cash flow and financial forecasts and walking through the numbers together so we can plan ahead with confidence

Flagging issues early, anomalies, overdrawn accounts, cash flow pinch points, tax and compliance items, before they catch us off guard

Working directly with the director to build a custom finance dashboard, plus any automations and tools you need to make the role easier, this is how we operate across every department at OPT, we build the systems that remove the grind

Keeping a consistent rhythm so the books never fall behind and we always know exactly where we stand



Skills We're Looking For

This role is equal parts bookkeeper, payroll manager, and finance analyst. You're the person who brings order and accuracy to the numbers, and clarity when the director needs to understand them.



Deep, current expertise with Xero, reconciliation, transaction coding, chart of accounts, payroll, and reporting, this is the single most important thing we're looking for

A solid grounding in accounting and bookkeeping fundamentals, double-entry, accruals, and a real understanding of how the numbers fit together

Hands-on payroll experience, running pay runs and reconciling them accurately and on time

Confident managing accounts receivable and chasing payments, comfortable following up on overdue invoices and coordinating with account managers to get them resolved

Comfortable living in financial data, building and maintaining forecasts, reading reports, and turning what you see into clear, plain-English insight for the director

Demonstrated accuracy and consistency managing a full set of books without things slipping through the cracks

Strong written English and clear communication, you'll be working directly with the director

Experience with NZ accounting, payroll, and tax (or multi-currency work across NZD, USD, and AUD) is a strong bonus, as is a CPA/CA qualification, but neither is a hard requirement



What We Offer



$800–$1,600 USD/month, depending on experience, with room above for a qualified accountant who can take on deeper financial analysis and forecasting

Fully remote, work from anywhere in the Philippines

A fast-growing agency where the finance function is yours to own and build, not a seat where you're one of many

Direct access to the director, and a company that builds custom dashboards, automations, and tools across every department to make your job easier

Clear processes and a genuine opportunity to grow as our brand scales

The chance to bring order to a growing business's finances and play a direct role in how we plan, spend, and scale



We're reviewing applicants now and will be in touch quickly with those who are the right match.

Thanks for your time,

The OPT Digital Team

description:
Creative Strategist — Aesthetic Acquisition Remote | Full-time | $2,000 USD/month + performance bonuses



The job

We run paid ads for aesthetic clinics across the United States — anti-aging and body sculpting campaigns targeting women aged 30-65. One audience. One goal. Keep the Cost Per Lead under $10.

The creative is everything. It is the only variable that moves the needle. Your job is to understand what is working, build on it, and keep a constant pipeline of fresh concepts flowing to the creative team.

Analysing ad performance data to identify winning creatives — what is working, what is not, and why. Developing new concepts and angles based on that data. Building variations of winning ads. Briefing the creative team — a graphic designer and a video editor — with clear, detailed direction so they can produce without guessing.

You understand what stops a woman aged 30-65 mid-scroll, makes her feel something, and gets her to fill out a form. You can look at an ad and know intuitively why it is converting — or why it is not. You think in hooks, emotions, and outcomes — not features and treatments.

title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central Administrator for an Australian B-Corp Company!
description:
Our company 



Pablo & Rusty’s Coffee Roasters is a specialty coffee roaster based in Sydney, Australia. We’re a B-Corp, 1% for the Planet, and Carbon Neutral Certified specialty coffee roaster committed to social, environmental, and impact goals and striving to help folks Drink Better Coffee™.   



Our mission is to positively impact people and our planet through coffee. We source specialty coffee directly from coffee farms and provide exceptional service to both wholesale and retail customers.   



We're a digital, design-centric, and sustainable company. Innovation drives everything we do, and we always look for ways to improve. We have high expectations of our tea
mbers and work collaboratively to achieve our goals. 



Join the team 

We are looking for a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central Administrator and Technical Specialist to build and own our in-house Business Central capabilities. You'll be our internal Microsoft expert: configuring and supporting the platform, building automations, and making sure our ERP genuinely works for the business, first through our implementation and then as the person who keeps it running and improving. 



Key duties and responsibilities: 

• Configure, administer and support Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central across Finance and Production, including perpetual inventory and product costing 

• Build and maintain automations and integrations using Power Automate and the Power Platform 

• Work hands-on with our implementation partner to validate configuration and resolve issues before they reach end users 

• Manage users, permissions, security and data integrity, and build the reports and dashboards the business needs 

• Provide ongoing support and troubleshooting after go-live, and continually find ways to make the system do more for us 



Qualifications and knowledge: 

• Demonstrated hands-on experience administering and configuring Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (essential) 

• Strong Business Central Finance experience, ideally with Manufacturing and Production, plus perpetual inventory and costing 

• Proficiency with Power Platform automation (Power Automate, Power Apps) and sound Microsoft 365 administration knowledge 

• Excellent problem-solving, outstanding written and verbal English, and the ability to work independently across time zones 

• Relevant Microsoft certifications and experience in manufacturing, wholesale or food and beverage are highly regarded 



What's in it for you 

First up: we want this role to be the best job you've ever had. That's our commitment to all of our team! That's not to say the work will be easy. It will, however, be fulfilling. You will grow personally and professionally, surrounded by a team that genuinely cares about our mission and about helping each other achieve it. 



We offer a generous package, HMO Program**, Quarterly Performance Bonus*, Volunteer and Training Leave, Philippine Public Holidays converted to Annual Leave Credits, access to ongoing training and development, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP). 



Importantly, you'll have first dibs on P&R merchandise (shirts, hoodies, jumpers and more) and get P&R coffee delivered directly to your place every month! 



*Qualifies for the Quarterly Performance Bonus after the probationary period. 

**Qualifies for the HMO Program after one year of tenure with P&R. 



Work schedule 

Four days per week to start, with potential to move to full-time. Working hours to overlap with Sydney business hours (Monday to Friday, AEST/AEDT). Specific days and hours by agreement. 



Join our team and make a difference in the world of coffee and beyond!

title: Junior Motion Designer (Adobe After Effects)
description:
We are looking for a full-time Junior/Intermediate After Effects Designer who wants to become an expert in Adobe After Effects and motion graphics.



We (Motion Current LLC) have been creating professional motion graphics for more than 20 years. Our work usually displayed on large LED screens and jumbotrons for casinos, banks, car dealerships, sports stadiums, and other businesses.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who enjoys learning, solving problems, and improving their skills every day.



You do not need to be an expert today. We are looking for someone who is motivated, dependable, and excited to learn.



The most important requirement is a strong desire to become an After Effects expert.



What We Are Looking For:

• Reliable and dependable

• Good communication skills

• Able to follow instructions

• Comfortable asking questions when needed

• Willing to learn (mostly) independently

• Interested in a long-term career in motion graphics

• Enjoys using AI tools to learn faster, solve problems, and generate graphics.



We expect the person we hire to spend a significant amount of time learning Adobe After Effects and Adobe Photoshop.



Daily Responsibilities:

• Check in through chat at the beginning of each workday is required. I don't want to use Timeproof unless necessary.

• Check out through chat at the end of each workday.

• Submit a daily report showing what you learned, created, or worked on.

• Include links to tutorials, resources, or projects completed during the day. We'll provide you with a Box.com account.

• Create motion graphic advertisements and animation projects.

• Continue learning new After Effects techniques and workflows.



First Few Weeks:

During the first few weeks, your main goal will be learning and practicing Adobe After Effects.



You will follow online tutorials (YouTube, chatgpt, other online resources), complete exercises (AI can help you learn faster), and build projects while learning. You should be familiar and comfortable with Keyframes, Layers, Animation basics, Rendering and exporting, and Project organization. Multiple 10-second projects are expected each week during this stage.



Next Stage:

As your skills improve, you will begin creating original motion graphics without relying on step-by-step tutorials. You will be able to build / modify assets in Adobe Photoshop or using AI that are used in your motion graphic animations. You should be comfortable with Easy Easing, Masks, Blend Modes, Motion design principles, and Professional workflows. Multiple 10-second projects will continue to be expected each week.



Long-Term Growth:

Over time, the goal is to become an advanced After Effects designer. You will be able to recreate almost any type of commercial motion graphic you see. You know how to build advanced projects from scratch, create reusable After Effects templates, work with expressions, build complex pre-compositions, design projects for multiple screen sizes and aspect ratios, create graphics using AI-generated and custom-built assets.



As your skills continue to grow, you will also learn Blender, Video Copilot Element 3D, and other 3D animation and motion design workflows.



Requirements:

• Your own computer. It needs to be able to run Adobe After Effects 2026.

• Internet connection. We will ask you about your speed and how frequently you have outages.

• Interest in learning and using AI tools.



After you are hired, we'll provide an Adobe license and access to share files on Box.com. 



Work Schedule:

The first few days of training and onboarding will be completed during our time zone (Mountain Time Zone) of the United States. We're based in Utah. Once training and onboarding is completed, expectations are understood, and communication systems are established, you can transition to working Philippine hours.



Please include a portfolio, website, demo reel, or examples of your motion graphics work. Applications without examples of any type of graphics work will not be considered.



If you advance to the interview process, you will be required to complete a 5 to 10 minute test in After Effects during the interview process with us so we can evaluate your current level of skill in After Effects. This will be done during the video call interview. We will share monitors and allow you to have keyboard and mouse control temporarily to do this test. This test will be on a PC (Windows 11) with After Effects 2026. We will show you a completed motion graphic 10-second animation and give you the assets (images/videos) required to recreate this animation. You will be given 5 to 10 minutes to recreate the completed animation.



Application Instructions:

To confirm that you read this entire job posting, begin your application with the words: "AE is After Effects".



Long-Term Opportunity:

We are looking for someone to grow with our company for years, not weeks or months. The right person can eventually become our Lead Template Designer and help build our growing motion graphics template library.



Compensation:

Starting salary: $1,200 - $2,000 USD per month, depending on experience, skill level, and portfolio. This amount does not include any additional money to cover the 2% forex fee. Payment will be processed through Easypay / Payoneer.



Annual performance reviews and salary increases are available as skills improve and responsibilities grow.

# Junior Technical QA Associate — Architecture / Engineering Background



**Fully Remote | Philippines | Contractor Role**



If you are eager to learn, detail-oriented, and excited to work on the future of how buildings are designed, built, analyzed, and operated, we would love to meet you.

mbers.

title: YouTube Vlog Editor / Retention Editor for Weekly Lifestyle and Brand Vlogs
description:
YouTube Vlog Editor / Retention Editor for Weekly Lifestyle & Brand Vlogs



We are looking for an experienced YouTube video editor to edit weekly iPhone-style lifestyle vlogs for a growing personal/brand YouTube channel.



This is not a basic cutting job. We need someone who understands YouTube pacing, retention, thumbnails, titles, hooks, and how to turn raw lifestyle footage into a video people actually want to keep watching.



The videos will be filmed mostly on iPhone. The footage will include day-to-day lifestyle, behind-the-scenes 
nts, building a clothing brand, working out, eating, business, travel, creative direction, and general vlog-style content.



The final videos will usually be around 15–20 minutes long.



Video Style - The style should feel like a fast-paced lifestyle vlog with consistent clip changes.

Most clips should be around 5–20 seconds max unless there is an important direct-to-camera 
nt or a serious story section that needs more time.



The goal is clip after clip after clip, while still making the video feel natural, entertaining, and easy to follow.



Reference style: Levi Bent-Lee, Jet Bent-Lee, Marcus Milione and similar lifestyle vlog creators. We do not want to copy anyone directly, but we want someone who understands that type of pacing, storytelling, and YouTube culture.

Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:

1. Editing 1 long-form YouTube vlog per week

2. Turning raw iPhone footage into a 15–20 minute engaging vlog

3. Watching through all footage and selecting the best 
nts

4. Creating a strong hook/opening for each video

5. Building the story of the vlog, not just cutting clips together

6. Keeping the pacing fast and engaging

7. Removing dead space, boring 
nts, and unnecessary pauses

8. Using non-copyrighted music

9. Adding sound effects or 
s only when they fit naturally

10. Making the video entertaining without making it feel childish, corny, or overly 
-heavy

11. Creating multiple engaging thumbnail options

12. Providing title options based on proven YouTube title styles that work for similar videos

13. Delivering the first final cut by Monday each week

14. Completing revisions before the video is posted on Wednesday or Thursday

15. Thumbnail & Title Expectations

16. Thumbnails and titles are extremely important for this role.

17. The editor must understand that a good video is not enough if the thumbnail and title do not make people click.



For each video, you should provide:

- Multiple thumbnail options

- 3–5 strong title options

- Titles that are inspired by proven YouTube formats from similar lifestyle vlog channels

- Thumbnails that are clear, clickable, emotional, and attention-grabbing

- You may create thumbnails from screenshots in the video or design them from scratch. The only requirement is that they must be strong enough to make people want to click.



Requirements

- You must have experience editing YouTube videos, especially vlog-style content.

- You should understand:

- YouTube retention editing

- Fast-paced vlog pacing

- Strong hooks

- Storytelling through clips

- Music selection

- 
/sound effect timing

- YouTube titles and thumbnails

- How to make simple iPhone footage feel entertaining

- YouTube culture and internet humor



You must be efficient at using at least one of the following:

- Premiere Pro

- Final Cut Pro

- DaVinci Resolve

- CapCut

- After Effects



Schedule

We are looking to post 1 YouTube video every Wednesday or Thursday.



You will receive raw footage by Thursday or Friday. The first full cut should be delivered by Monday so we have time for revisions before posting. Giving you 3-4 days to edit the video. 



Two rounds of revisions are included per video. And final cuts need to be finished by Wednesday or Thursday so we can post.



Pay

Starting pay is $200 per completed video.



There is room for higher pay based on quality, consistency, speed, and performance.



Performance bonuses are available based on results within the first 30 days after a video is posted, including:

- Views

- Subscribers gained

- Retention / average view duration

- Overall monthly channel performance



For example, bonuses may be given if a video reaches certain view milestones within 30 days, such as 1,000 views, 5,000 views, 10,000 views, or higher.



The better the videos perform, the more opportunity there is to earn.



Paid Sample Edit

Top applicants may be asked to complete a short paid sample edit.



The sample edit will be 2–3 minutes using provided iPhone vlog footage. This will help us test your pacing, storytelling, music selection, hook, retention editing, and ability to make raw footage feel entertaining.



Sample edit pay will be $15–$30 depending on the assignment.



How To Apply



To apply, please send:

1. Your resume or a short summary of your editing experience

2. Links to YouTube videos or vlog-style videos you have edited

3. Examples of thumbnails you have created

4. A 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and showing your experience with Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or After Effects

5. Analytics, screenshots, or performance results from previous videos if available

6. Your usual turnaround time for a 15–20 minute vlog

7. Your internet speed and computer specs

8. Why you think you would be a good fit for this role



Put the word “VLOG” in your subject line so we know you read the full post.

Generic applications will be ignored. We are looking for someone who understands YouTube, retention, pacing, thumbnails, and how to make lifestyle content feel engaging.

title: Website Project Manager
description:
Web Project Manager: Full Time



An exciting opportunity exists for a Project Manager in the online marketing and website design industry.



This position is suited to someone who loves organising and interacting with clients.



From client onboarding, setting them up in our project management system, to sending the briefing questionnaires, collating their responses and information for the website project.



To oversight on the design, managing the actual build, then to client preview, to the final site go live process.



Project Management requires high attention to detail. That starts NOW, if you can't follow the job ad process then you will automatically exclude your application from consideration.



Must have a reliable internet connection and good PC.

MUST know WordPress (not just how to spell it).

Must understand website design.



NOTE: Please submit a voice recording explaining why you are the best person for the job.



===============================================================================



Remuneration by agreement

• Permanent Basis (long term)

• 40 hours per week

• Rapidly growing company (Lots of work on its books)



The company is situated in Perth, Western Australia (So same time zone as the Philippines).



MUSTS:

• Good spoken English

• Good written English

===============================================================================

Customer Service & Admin Support

• Customer Support

•
 Support

• Phone Support



Project Management

• Design Project Management

• Web Development Project Management

===============================================================================



We build websites, from business start-ups to sophisticated high level websites.



We also do SEO, social media, copywriting, and most things digital marketing or website related.



Website project management is a high attention to detail role. You cannot fake attention to detail, you either have it, or you don’t.



Don’t waste your time or ours if that’s not you.



From when a new client comes on board, to the briefing, data collation and tracking, guidance with the client for the layout and website functionality, and then through to design concepts, and then onto tasking and liaising with the design and build team for the actual build and implementation.



This is a marketing ideas role, and a communication role requiring good interpersonal skills.



EG: In a recent simple project the client had 3 primary services, hats, shirts and badges. In the design layout and function briefing it was d
 we were to create 3 primary ‘doorway’ buttons on one row on the homepage linking to those product pages.



The client then requested a 4th button to showcase suppliers.



We could do that, add a 4th button on that one row, no problems.



But, was that a good marketing or design decision? Was it going to be in the client’s best interest?



Should that page have the same priority as the 3 main product pages?



What would your response have been to that client’s request?



We have broken the website build process into 10 distinct stages, from project setup and client onboarding right through to design and build and onto quality assurance, a clear ‘go live’ process and handover steps to project completion rap up.



There are 560 specific steps in this process, and it’s the project managers role to make sure they’re all adhered to in their fullness but a timely manner to deliver a high-end product.



Software we use:

• Teamwork: For client communication, project management, time tracking.

• Zoom

• Slack for team comms

• WHMCS for client support

• Process St for ALL processes and systems

• Trello for tasking

• RoboForm for password management

• OneDrive for all file assets



What does your day look like?

• Morning check in – Daily Focus session

• Check
s for project notifications, respond

• Follow up with clients

• Follow up with team, and check tasks previously assigned

• Ensure that new project tasks are assigned to team

• Liaise with clients

• Handle brief questionnaires with clients

• Handle layout and function briefings with clients

• Check off that process has been adhered to

• Manage team and resources



Here’s the question:



Can you see your existing skills sets being suited to these daily tasks?



We have a local tech, who handles the phones, helps in support and also does our SEO.



We have another local tech, who handles the hosting, website version updates, managed support and all things WordPress for clients.



We have several designers and web build dev’s who handles the design concepts, and the actual build as such.



We also have a remote marketing person, who is our CRM specialist on the team.



There is also a content marketing and social media specialist.



So, is that you?



Remember, don’t theorise about this!



Website project management is a high attention to detail role. You cannot fake attention to detail, you either have it, or you don’t.



Don’t waste your time or ours if that’s not you.

title: Lead Generation Specialist – Wholesale Real Estate
description:
# Lead Generation Specialist – Wholesale Real Estate



## About Us



CPN Housing LLC is a growing wholesale real estate company focused on acquiring off-market properties and creating win-win solutions for homeowners. We are looking for a dedicated and detail-oriented Lead Generation Specialist to help build and maintain a consistent pipeline of motivated seller leads.



## Position Overview



The Lead Generation Specialist will be responsible for researching, identifying, and organizing potential motivated seller leads. This role is critical to the success of our acquisitions team by ensuring a steady flow of qualified prospects for follow-up and contract negotiations.



The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, tech-savvy, and capable of working independently while meeting daily lead generation goals.



## Responsibilities



* Research and identify motivated seller leads.

* Build targeted lead lists based on company criteria.

* Locate off-market property opportunities.

* Identify absentee owners, vacant properties, tired landlords, probate leads, tax-delinquent properties, and high-equity homeowners.

* Gather and verify property owner information.

* Skip trace property owners when needed.

* Upload and manage lead data within CRM systems.

* Maintain accurate records and notes.

* Remove duplicate and inaccurate records.

* Update lead statuses and organize pipelines.

* Provide daily and weekly lead generation reports.

* Work closely with the acquisitions team to ensure lead quality.



## Requirements



* Previous lead generation experience preferred.

* Experience in wholesale real estate is a plus.

* Strong research and data entry skills.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Comfortable using CRM software.

* Strong organizational skills.

* Reliable internet connection and computer.

* Ability to meet daily production goals.

* Self-motivated and results-driven.



## Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



* Generate 100–200+ qualified leads daily.

* Maintain accurate and organized CRM records.

* Achieve weekly lead generation goals.

* Deliver consistent lead quality.

* Provide timely reporting and updates.



## Compensation



* Hourly Pay: $4–$8 per hour (based on experience)

* Performance bonuses available for high-quality leads that result in appointments or contracts.



## Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who is proactive, detail-oriented, and committed to helping our company grow. The ideal candidate takes ownership of their work, follows processes consistently, and understands the importance of providing quality leads to support our acquisitions team.

title: AI OPERATING SYSTEM COORDINATOR
description:
AI OPERATING SYSTEM COORDINATOR

Hermes Agent Deployment Specialist

Part-Time Contractor  •  Remote  •  Async-Friendly

Role Type Part-time contractor (hourly)

Pay Rate Up to $20/hr USD — based on experience

Hours/Week Est. 10–20 hrs/week (flexible, async workflow)

Location 100% remote — Philippines-based preferred

Platform ForgeOS + Hermes Agent Framework

Start Date ASAP / Immediate



About Strategic Intelligence, Inc.

Strategic Intelligence is building the memory layer for the agentic era. Our core product, ForgeOS, is an AI-powered organizational decision memory (ODM) system that helps businesses capture, structure, and act on institutional knowledge — powered by AI agents deployed through the Hermes framework.

We work with forward-thinking organizations across legal, consulting, and professional services — helping them replace scattered notes and tribal knowledge with living, queryable decision systems. Our co-founders include a marketing professor and AI strategist (Prof Z) and a principal engineer with a background in large-scale systems (ex-DreamWorks).

This is early-stage, high-impact work. You’ll be on the ground floor of something genuinely new.



The Role

We are looking for a technically sharp, systems-minded AI Operating System Coordinator to build, deploy, and manage Hermes AI agents for new client engagements. This is not a passive support role — you will be an active builder operating within a hybrid system: part structured playbook, part frontier problem-solving.

You’ll work directly with our founding team to onboard new clients onto the ForgeOS platform, configure and deploy tailored Hermes agents, integrate external tools via MCP, and ensure each deployment runs reliably and delivers value.



What You’ll Do

AGENT DEPLOYMENT & CONFIGURATION

• Deploy and configure Hermes AI agents for new client environments

• Customize agent behavior using structured prompts, decision logic, and workflow rules

• Build and maintain agent memory layers using Obsidian markdown vaults and Supabase databases

• Test, iterate, and document agent deployments before client handoff

MCP & TOOL INTEGRATION

• Set up and manage MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations including Gmail, Google Calendar, and Slack

• Connect GoHighLevel CRM workflows to agent triggers and outputs

• Integrate and coordinate across AI platforms including OpenClaw, Manus, and Orgo as needed

• Troubleshoot integration failures and maintain connection reliability

CLIENT SYSTEM SETUP

• Onboard new clients onto ForgeOS — configure vaults, Decision Card templates, and agent access

• Translate client workflows and pain points into agent logic and automation rules

• Document every deployment in a structured runbook for handoff and future maintenance

• Communicate deployment status and blockers clearly to the founding team

SYSTEM OPERATIONS & IMPROVEMENT

• Monitor active agent deployments for performance, errors, and drift

• Maintain an organized internal knowledge base of deployment patterns and solutions

• Identify opportunities to improve playbooks, templates, and agent configurations

• Contribute ideas for new agent use cases and workflow automations



What We’re Looking For

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

• Hands-on experience building and deploying AI agents or automation workflows

• Strong prompt engineering skills — you know how to get reliable, structured outputs from LLMs

• Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or ability to learn it quickly

• Experience with APIs, webhooks, and tool integrations (no deep coding required, but comfort with technical configuration is essential)

• Obsidian or markdown-based knowledge management experience (or strong willingness to learn)

• Familiarity with Supabase or relational databases for storing and querying structured data

• Excellent written English — for documentation, client-facing runbooks, and async communication

• Self-directed and organized — you manage your own tasks and flag blockers without being chased

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with GoHighLevel or other CRM/automation platforms

• Familiarity with OpenClaw, Manus, Orgo, or similar AI agent platforms

• Background in operations, systems design, or workflow architecture

• Interest in organizational knowledge management, decision intelligence, or agentic AI

• Experience supporting B2B SaaS or professional services clients



What We Provide

• A structured onboarding playbook and ForgeOS architecture documentation to get you up to speed fast

• Direct access to the founding team — you’ll work closely with Prof Z and our lead engineer

• Real clients, real deployments — this is not test work or spec projects

• Room to innovate — if you see a better way to build or deploy, we want to hear it

• Consistent part-time hours with potential to grow as we scale client engagements

• Front-row seat to one of the most exciting areas in applied AI — agentic organizational systems



How to Apply

We review every application personally. Please send us the following:

• A short intro: who you are, your background, and why this role excites you

• 2–3 examples of AI agents, automations, or technical workflows you’ve built (links, screenshots, or descriptions accepted)

• Your experience with any of the following: MCP integrations, Obsidian, Supabase, GoHighLevel, OpenClaw, Manus, or Orgo

• Your hourly rate, weekly availability, and time zone



Applications without examples of technical work will not be reviewed. Show us what you’ve built.



Bonus points: Record a 2–3 minute Loom video walking us through something you’ve built. It doesn’t need to be polished — we just want to see how you think.



We’re building the memory layer for the agentic era. Come build it with us.

 or contact button in their bio.





OVERVIEW & DETAILS

Pixies Brew is a specialty coffee brand built around ritual, intention, and slowing down. Each blend is a little pixie character with its own personality. The brand vibe is calm, aesthetic, whimsical, story-driven.



Brand 



Target niches (creator must fit at least one):

- Specialty coffee

- Slow living / aesthetic morning routines

- Cozy / cottagecore lifestyle

- Bookish, journaling, or creative content (booktok, art, playlists)

- Travel or camping lifestyle



Good fit: Soft, aesthetic creators. Calm pacing. Natural lighting. World-building energy.



Bad fit: Loud creators. Hustle culture. Energy drinks. Gaming. "Main character" personalities.





EXAMPLES OF CREATORS WE'VE LOOKED AT

(These are profiles, not real handles. Finding real creators that match is your job.)

- ~15K on Instagram - Slow aesthetic morning routines, journaling, soft warm color grading. High saves and comments.

- ~40K on TikTok - Specialty coffee reviews, tasting notes, pour-over gear.

nts.

Look at the last 5 posts on the platform you list them under.

2. Avg comments = total comments from last 5 posts divided by 5

3. Engagement Rate = ((avg likes + avg comments) divided by follower count) x 100

title: Senior Remote Operations & Listings Manager (Luxury Second-Hand Watches | Long-term Remote)
description:
About Us

We are a luxury second-hand watch company handling high-value, one-of-one timepieces daily.

Every item is unique — only 1 unit per listing.



We operate across premium sales channels including:

• Chrono24

• Shopify

• eBay

• 1stDibs

•
 Marketplace

• WhatsApp groups



This is a high-trust, high-accuracy operational role where mistakes directly affect revenue and customer trust.



Who This Role Is For

We are only looking for experienced operators, not beginners.



You should apply ONLY if you:

• Have at least 2–3 years experience in e-commerce operations or listings

• Have handled multi-platform inventory or high-value products

• Understand accuracy > speed > volume hierarchy

• Are confident working independently without supervision

• Are comfortable managing real-time inventory for unique items



Core Responsibility

You will be responsible for ensuring that:

Every listing is accurate, updated in real time, and reflects actual stock (1 item only per product).

Inventory mistakes are unacceptable in this role.



Key Responsibilities

• Manage and publish luxury watch listings across all platforms

• Maintain real-time inventory accuracy (1-of-1 items)

• Upload and update product details with precision (model, specs, pricing, photos)

• Handle customer enquiries using templates and brand tone

• Qualify leads and manage appointment scheduling

• Update availability immediately after any customer interaction

• Remove sold items across all platforms without delay

• Maintain structured tracking sheets (listings, enquiries, inventory status)

• Identify and report issues proactively (listing errors, customer concerns, system problems)

• Assist in daily operational coordination



Non-Negotiable Standards

• Zero tolerance for careless listing errors

• Must be highly responsive during working hours

• Must understand luxury customer expectations

• Must proactively flag issues (not wait to be asked)

• Must double-check all work before publishing

• Must maintain strict discipline in inventory tracking

• Must be comfortable being accountable for accuracy



Preferred Experience (Strong Advantage)

• Chrono24 dealer account management

• Shopify product operations

• eBay high-volume listings

• 1stDibs luxury goods experience



Required Mindset

• Treat every item as high-value and irreplaceable

• Prioritize accuracy over speed

• Think like an operator, not a poster

• Own problems until they are resolved

• Communicate clearly and proactively



Daily Reporting (Mandatory)

You must submit a structured daily report:

• Listings created/updated

• Enquiries handled

• Inventory changes (critical)

• Items sold/removed

• Issues encountered

• Pending actions for next day



This Role Is NOT Suitable For

• Entry-level VA applicants

• Freelancers juggling multiple clients

• People who need constant instructions

• Anyone unfamiliar with structured SOP environments

• Candidates without prior e-commerce operations experience



Working Arrangement

• 5 days - 6 days per week

• 9 hours daily

• Fully remote

• Must be consistently responsive during working hours



Compensation

• 30k - 40k Peso



How to Apply

Please make your application through the link below





Application Deadline

Applications close 15 June 2026. Only shortlisted senior candidates will be contacted.

title: Immigration Operations Executive
description:
Job Summary

Direct Singapore Advisory (DSA) is seeking a dedicated and highly organized Immigration Operations Executive to manage client cases throughout the entire immigration journey.

The successful candidate will serve as the primary point of contact for clients from onboarding through application preparation, submission, follow-up management, and post-submission support for Singapore Permanent Residence (PR) and Singapore Citizenship applications.

This role requires strong client communication skills, attention to detail, case coordination capabilities, and the ability to manage multiple client portfolios simultaneously while maintaining high service standards and confidentiality.

The Immigration Operations Executive plays a critical role in ensuring a seamless client experience and maintaining effective communication between clients, consultants, management, and supporting stakeholders throughout the application lifecycle.

________________________________________

Key Responsibilities

Client Onboarding & Case Management

• Receive and onboard new clients from the Sales Team upon successful engagement. 

• Create and manage dedicated WhatsApp communication groups for each client. 

• Conduct onboarding briefings and explain the overall application process, timelines, documentation requirements, and milestones. 

• Maintain accurate client records and update internal tracking systems regularly. 

• Act as the primary case coordinator throughout the client's engagement with DSA. 

Client Communication & Relationship Management

• Manage daily communication with clients through WhatsApp,
, phone calls, and meetings. 

• Provide timely updates regarding case progress, documentation requirements, and submission timelines. 

• Respond professionally to client enquiries and concerns throughout the engagement period. 

• Follow up proactively to ensure clients meet documentation deadlines. 

• Build strong and professional relationships while maintaining high levels of client satisfaction. 

Documentation & Application Coordination

• Collect, review, organize, and verify supporting documents required for Singapore PR and Citizenship applications. 

• Ensure document consistency, completeness, and compliance with submission requirements. 

• Coordinate with clients to obtain additional supporting documents where necessary. 

• Maintain proper digital filing and document management practices. 

• Work closely with consultants and management to ensure case readiness before submission. 

Submission & Post-Submission Support

• Coordinate the preparation and submission process for Singapore PR and Citizenship applications. 

• Monitor application progress and maintain submission records. 

• Assist clients with post-submission requests, updates, or additional document requirements. 

• Continue managing client communications throughout the waiting period until final outcome. 

• Provide after-service support for approved and unsuccessful applications. 

• Coordinate follow-up consultations and reapplication planning for rejected cases where required. 

Internal Operations Support

• Coordinate with the Sales Team regarding new client handovers and case transitions. 

• Work closely with management on case scheduling, operational updates, and workflow improvements. 

• Prepare case status reports and operational updates when required. 

• Ensure compliance with company procedures, confidentiality standards, and data protection requirements. 

• Support operational initiatives to improve client experience and case management efficiency. 



Requirements

• Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Customer Service, Communications, Legal Studies, Human Resources, or related disciplines. 

• Minimum 1-3 years of experience in customer service, client management, case management, immigration consultancy, administrative operations, or related fields. 

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills. 

• Excellent written and spoken English. 

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy. 

• Ability to manage multiple client cases and deadlines simultaneously. 

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business, and digital document management systems. 

• Ability to work independently while maintaining strong teamwork and coordination. 

• Professional, patient, and service-oriented personality. 

• Experience in Singapore immigration consultancy, PR applications, Citizenship applications, work pass processing, legal support services, or customer relationship management will be an added advantage.

title: AI VISUAL CONTENT CREATOR
description:
About the role

We're an e-commerce team launching ~50 products per week across multiple brands. We need someone to produce premium product visuals — independently, at volume, with a 12–24h turnaround.

Each brand has its own visual identity. You'll receive a detailed brief for every brand so you always know exactly what's expected.

- Deliver 4 to 7 images per product following each brand's visual guidelines

- Write AI-generated product descriptions and upload everything to Shopify (no prior experience needed — simple process, we'll walk you through it)

- Video creation with AI tools (Veo 3 / VO3) — a bonus, not required





What we need

- Experience with AI image generation and prompt writing — results should be right the first time

- Strong eye for quality: lighting, composition, color consistency, realistic-looking AI models

- Fast, reliable, autonomous — instructions given once, updates shared proactively

- Same-day responses on WhatsApp, status always up to date on shared Google Sheets



How we work

Contract: Freelance / Part-time / Full-time — based on profile

2.  If your profile looks good, we'll send a paid technical test (1–2 products at $1.50/product).

3.  If the test is satisfactory, we schedule a call.

title: Marketing AI Content Strategist
description:
About Chamelo

Chamelo is a celebrity-backed brand growing triple digits. We bootstrapped our way to 8-figures and are about to close a VC round with the goal to accelerate growth toward an IPO.

At Chamelo, we’re engineering a new era of smart eyewear by combining state-of-the-art technology with cutting-edge style. Our mission goes beyond creating dynamic and stylish glasses—we’re pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in a traditionally static industry.



Our eyewear isn’t just functional—it’s bold, customizable, and effortlessly cool. Backed by iconic figures like Shaquille O’Neal and Bad Bunny, Chamelo is on pace for rapid expansion, offering an exciting opportunity to be part of our growth story.



About the Role



We are looking for an AI Content Strategist to lead the development of high-performing content systems powered by AI tools and automation. This role combines creative storytelling, growth marketing, and emerging AI technologies to help Chamelo scale content production across social media, ecommerce,
, paid ads, and organic channels.

You will work closely with the creative, marketing, and ecommerce teams to build AI-enhanced workflows that improve speed, efficiency, and content performance while maintaining strong brand identity and storytelling.

The ideal candidate is deeply familiar with AI-powered content creation tools, understands internet culture and performance marketing, and thrives in a fast-paced startup environment.



Key Responsibilities



AI-Powered Content Strategy

Develop and execute multi-platform content strategies using AI tools and automation.

Create systems for generating high-volume, high-quality marketing content efficiently.

Use AI tools for ideation, scripting, copywriting, trend analysis, and campaign optimization.

Build scalable workflows for content production across organic and paid channels.

Creative & Brand Development

Maintain Chamelo’s tone, voice, and visual storytelling across all channels.

Collaborate with designers, editors, and marketing teams on campaign concepts.

Research viral trends, hooks, and emerging content formats.

Help produce engaging content for TikTok, Instagram, Meta Ads,
 campaigns, and product launches.

Analytics & Optimization

Track content performance metrics and identify growth opportunities.

Use data insights to optimize engagement, conversion rates, and retention.

Test AI-generated variations of hooks, captions, creatives, and ad copy.

Continuously improve content systems based on performance feedback.

Cross-Team Collaboration

Work with paid media, ecommerce, and influencer teams to support launches and campaigns.

Help implement AI tools and SOPs across the marketing department.

Support rapid experimentation and creative testing initiatives.



Qualifications

title: AI Video Creator
description:
We're not hiring someone to "make videos." We're hiring someone to move humans — to take the raw clay of footage, AI tools, and a story worth telling, and shape it into something that makes a stranger stop scrolling, lean in, and feel something real. Then act on it.





Who You Are 



You're a Storyteller First, Technologist Second. Anyone can prompt an AI tool. Almost nobody can tell a story that makes a CFO tear up at a B2B brand video. That's the gap we're hiring for.



You're Emotionally Intelligent — and It Shows in the Work. You can read a room, read a brief, and read a person's face on camera and know when they're holding back. You understand that great marketing isn't about being clever — it's about being true. You make people feel seen. That's the unfair advantage you bring.







- You're Motivated by Impact, Not Output. You don't measure your week in videos shipped. You measure it in whether the work moved someone — a customer, a candidate, a community. You'd rather make 10 videos that matter than 100 that don't.



- You Have Range. You can make us laugh on Tuesday and make us cry on Thursday. You can write a 15-second hook and a 6-minute brand film. You can shoot on an iPhone in a coffee shop and direct a polished studio piece.



You Move Fast Without Breaking Trust. You ship. You iterate. You don't disappear into perfectionism for three weeks. But you also don't publish anything you wouldn't be proud to sign your name to.



You're a Pro With AI — Not a Tourist. You've already built workflows nobody taught you. You know which tools are hype and which are durable. You know when to use AI and, more importantly, when not to.







Non-Negotiables



- Portfolio that makes us jealous. Show us the work. We'd rather see three pieces you're proud of than a sizzle reel of everything you've ever touched.

- 3+ years producing video for marketing or brand, ideally in a fast-moving environment where you weren't handed a 50-page brand book.

- Demonstrated AI fluency. You can walk us through a video you made where AI was central to the workflow — and explain the choices, including the human ones.

- Strong writing. If you can't write, you can't make great video. Period.

- You actually like people. This job involves real humans on camera. They'll feel how you feel about them.



The chance to build something. A team that takes the work seriously and themselves lightly. Direct line to leadership — your ideas get heard, your wins get noticed, your work goes out the door. Compensation that matches the talent we're looking for. And the rare gift of doing work you can point to in five years and say: that one mattered.
